all_candidates.topic: Are motorists genuinely saving money with E20 petrol now, as claimed?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The government claimed on August 1, 2026, that E20 petrol saved consumers nearly Rs 30 per litre during crude price spikes, while critics raise concerns about lower fuel efficiency.

all_candidates.topic: Should national entrance exams like NEET-UG be entirely scrapped?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The 2026 NEET-UG examination was cancelled due to a paper leak and irregularities, leading to widespread protests and calls for systemic change. (CBI revelations July 30-Aug 1, 2026).

all_candidates.topic: Is the National Testing Agency (NTA) capable of conducting fair exams?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Recent CBI investigations (July 30-Aug 1, 2026) into the 2026 NEET-UG paper leak revealed internal lapses and a network involving NTA subject experts and coaching operators.

all_candidates.topic: Is mandatory two-factor authentication for UPI transactions necessary?
all_candidates.news_anchor: New UPI rules from April 1, 2026, mandated two-factor authentication for most transactions to enhance security and combat fraud.

all_candidates.topic: Are AI-driven layoffs in the Indian IT sector justifiable for efficiency?
all_candidates.news_anchor: India's IT sector is facing potential job losses (estimated 25,000-35,000 in 2026) due to AI adoption and restructuring. (Articles from July 9, 2026, July 18, 2026 discuss this).

all_candidates.topic: Was increasing passport fees by 66% from July 1st justified?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The Ministry of External Affairs increased passport fees by 66% effective July 1, 2026, the first revision since 2012.

all_candidates.topic: Should the government aggressively promote E20 fuel despite mileage concerns?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The government defended E20 ethanol-blended petrol program on August 1, 2026, stating it saved consumers Rs 30/litre during crude price spikes, amidst criticism about its impact on vehicles and fuel efficiency.

all_candidates.topic: Should pure petrol also be available at pumps alongside E20 fuel?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) started a campaign on Saturday (July 26 or 27, 2026) demanding petrol pumps offer both E20 and pure petrol.

all_candidates.topic: Should railway fines for ticketless travel be more than doubled?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Indian Railways increased fines for offences like ticketless travel, with minimum penalties more than doubling, effective July 1, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Should users have a 'kill-switch' option to disable all digital payments instantly?
all_candidates.news_anchor: RBI's discussion paper (April 10, 2026) proposed a 'kill-switch' control to instantly disable all digital payment modes in case of fraud.

all_candidates.topic: Should coaching centers be held liable for exam paper leaks?
all_candidates.news_anchor: CBI investigations (July 30-Aug 1, 2026) into the 2026 NEET-UG paper leak implicated coaching institute operators in the scandal.

all_candidates.topic: Should companies be transparent about AI's role in workforce reductions?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Layoffs in the tech sector are increasingly linked to AI adoption, with companies often not explicitly stating AI as the reason, leading to 'silent layoffs'. (Articles from July 9, 2026, July 18, 2026 discuss this).

all_candidates.topic: Should states have full autonomy in their medical admission processes?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Following the 2026 NEET scandal, former Chief Minister M.K. Stalin urged the central government to exempt NEET-UG for the 2026 school year and allow states to determine their own medical admission process.

all_candidates.topic: Should all UPI transactions above ₹10,000 have a mandatory delay?
all_candidates.news_anchor: RBI's discussion paper (April 10, 2026) proposed a 1-hour mandatory delay for UPI transactions above ₹10,000 to combat fraud.

all_candidates.topic: Should all new city buses be mandated to be low-floor for accessibility?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The government mandated on January 19, 2026, that from October 2026, all city buses must be low-floor, aiming to improve accessibility.

all_candidates.topic: Will India's 'Intelligent India' transition truly benefit ordinary citizens?
all_candidates.news_anchor: India is transitioning from 'Digital India' to 'Intelligent India' by 2026, with AI, smart devices, and real-time data systems transforming public services and cities. (Published January 5, 2026, but the transition is ongoing).

all_candidates.topic: Will the new e-invoice and e-Way Bill system improve goods movement?
all_candidates.news_anchor: A structural change to the e-invoice and e-Way Bill architecture went live on August 1, 2026, affecting how businesses move goods.

all_candidates.topic: Should the government offer more subsidies for purchasing electric vehicles?
all_candidates.news_anchor: India's EV Policy 2026 (July 23, 2026) is accelerating electric mobility through government incentives, but challenges like cost still exist.

all_candidates.topic: Is the GSTN's new automatic AATO update system beneficial for businesses?
all_candidates.news_anchor: GSTN shifted the AATO amendment window (July 1-31, 2026) for FY 2025-26 as it deploys an upgraded functionality that will automatically update turnover.

all_candidates.topic: Will the new GST Invoice Management System simplify tax compliance?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The new GST return filing system changes for 2026 include mandatory Invoice Management System (IMS) for large taxpayers from July-September 2026.
